card.name: Small words in conditional or time phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words in label sentences right before a condition, time span, or conclusion, such as "been" after "until the infection has" or "about" after "conclusion". Also the space before a number of days or hours after "within".

modes.label: Until infection controlled
modes.description: The word "been" or "until" in the instruction to discontinue a topical product until infection is controlled.
modes.example: should be discontinued until the infection has<< been>> adequately controlled.

modes.label: Within a time span
modes.description: The blank spot after "within" just before a number of days or hours for expected response.
modes.example: Re-evaluate patients not showing a clinical response within<< >>3 to 5 days.

modes.label: Conclusion about drug effect
modes.description: The word "about" after "too small to allow any conclusion" in suicide-trial wording.
modes.example: the number is too small to allow any conclusion<< about>> drug effect on suicide.

card.writes: It seems to steer away from words meaning permanent or lasting, favoring temporary or conditional wording.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in label sentences that set a condition or time limit, like until, within, or about.
